name: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Ltd
title: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Ltd - 534139 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 sales flat at INR590 crore and margin hit by ~2.5% commodity drag; management held Q4 orders selectively and cited customer-requested delivery deferrals of 10-12%, with FY26 orders up 27.4%.

triggers.label: Customers asked to hold deliveries
triggers.quote: they are asking us to hold the dispatches and ship to the next quarter

triggers.label: Commodity drag ~2.5% on Q4 margin
triggers.quote: Almost 2.5% is coming from commodity and is coming from the sales.

triggers.label: Q4 order booking low by choice
triggers.quote: that selectivity made the reasoning to have a low order booking in the Q4

red_flags.label: Delivery deferrals and low Q4 bookings
red_flags.quote: they are asking us to hold the dispatches and ship to the next quarter

red_flags.label: Management evasive on data-centre quantification
red_flags.quote: we'll not be able to give you an absolute percentage number

red_flags.label: Gross margin down 160 bps FY26 vs FY25
red_flags.quote: from 39.1% in FY25 to 37.5% in FY26. And now it is 36.6% in Q4

evasions.quote: it is nothing which can be quantified
it's very difficult to quantify the market
I'm not sure we can take the numbers in this call.
